title: Independent hidden-set benchmark registry across roles, subjects and modalities
whatBuilt: PRE-REGISTRATION ENFORCED: numerical thresholds (min quality, per-slice noninferiority margin, max calibration error, max abstention rate, p95 latency, per-task cost, min cases per slice) plus a sample/power rationale registered by the INDEPENDENT CUSTODIAN before any evaluation exists; thresholds immutable; evaluations bind the thresholds digest (mismatch refused)

HIDDEN SET CUSTODIAN-SEALED: registry stores case digests + slice metadata only; expected answers never enter runner-visible records (registry refuses any case carrying an 'expected' key); deterministic seal digest commits the exact case set
GRADING CUSTODIAN-ONLY: the candidate runner records raw per-case results; a different independent custodian grades

PER-SLICE NONINFERIORITY: every slice (role x subject x modality + transfer/crossSession/toolBuild dimensions for the KAN-203 extension) must independently meet thresholds; abstained results score 0; binned ECE calibration gate (stdlib, deterministic); p95 latency and cost gates; min-cases-per-sample-rationale enforcement
Verdict records engineeringBenchmarkSuccess AND educationalGainsEstablished: False unconditionally (engineering benchmark success does not establish educational gains)
